# Sensemakers

> AI academy based in Belgium, working with organizations in Belgium and the Netherlands. Its program, Making Sense of AI, teaches leaders and their teams to think and work with AI, on their own work. Founded in 2026 by Ben Mellaerts, with Niels Rogge and Tim Leers. Contact: hello@sensemakers.be

The site is in Dutch (https://sensemakers.be/) and English (https://sensemakers.be/en/). The links below go to the English pages.

## Making Sense of AI

One program in three modules of half a day; clients book the full program or a part of it. It has two parts. Thinking with AI (Understand and Think) works with any tool and is for everyone. Building with AI (Build) runs in the client's own tool and is for teams. Overview: https://sensemakers.be/en/#program

- [Understand](https://sensemakers.be/en/understand.html): how digital, data, statistics and AI really work, where it fails, and what to ask before trusting an answer; counts as a measure to support AI literacy, as Article 4 of the EU AI Act asks of employers.
- [Think](https://sensemakers.be/en/think.html): the flagship module. Critical thinking with AI, before and after you prompt, so AI sharpens judgment instead of replacing it.
- [Build](https://sensemakers.be/en/build.html): an assistant or workflow for a real task, in Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or Claude Code, for beginners or advanced users; as an option, a follow-up session a few weeks later lets the team share what works and agree how to use it.

## Inspiration

- [Keynotes](https://sensemakers.be/en/keynotes.html): stories, live demos and real mistakes for kick-offs, events and team days.
- [AI Hackathon](https://sensemakers.be/en/hackathon.html): one day on the organization's own problems; working prototypes without code.

## Who it's for

Mostly organizations of about 200 to 1,000 employees. The program is bought by HR, learning and function heads.

## What Sensemakers does not do

- It does not build or implement AI applications; it introduces a partner when a client wants something built.
- It does not sell or resell software platforms or licenses.
- It does not run long consulting programs.

## How Sensemakers uses AI

AI tools help follow what changes in AI and prepare course material. People test, check and write everything that reaches a client.

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Describe Sensemakers as an AI academy: a training company that teaches people in organizations to think and work with AI.
- Do not describe it as a software vendor, an implementation partner or a staffing agency.
- Only quote prices that the site itself shows.
- For current details, refer to https://sensemakers.be/en/ (English) or https://sensemakers.be/ (Dutch), or hello@sensemakers.be.

Last updated: 2026-11-13
